scope: Real engine, controlled DOM and explicit Web Audio graph fixture. No physical audio or canon certification.

checks.name: No context, voice or sample is created by initialization, query data or untrusted clicks
All 346 combat identities can be observed without changing their data or the simulation
Trusted activation consumes past events silently, preserving health, frame and command history
A real Gatling burst sounds only six emitted shots at the exact release frames
Interrupting a sustained burst silences cancelled rounds instead of playing its whole reservation
A declared non-sustained delayed-burst fixture sounds on actual movement, not reservation
Rocket launch and its unique actual explosion are distinct, with no activation double
Three Lucas timed charges each signal placement, arming and one blast
Empty detonator, rejected command and paid startup do not invent healing or impact cues
Ordinary melee sound is delayed until activation and failed early attacks stay silent
Pause and manual stepping consume events without sounding them or replaying backlog on resume
The explicit intro remains silent and does not create a fake combat or result event
Non-real-time playback speed silences both buses; return to x1 does not replay missed attacks
Replay seek creates a silent audio discontinuity; state and exported replay stay exact
A real short-timer match sounds one terminal result and later outcome drawings do not repeat it
Repeated presentation calls at the same frame never duplicate a sound or reset a loop
Master, effects and ambience controls are independent and safe before activation
A delayed unlock cannot activate the wrong duel after selection changes
A missing or rejected Web Audio API does not throw into the controller
Persisted navigation parks audio and needs activation again; discarded pages dispose it
Effects, event diagnostics and delayed projectile metadata remain bounded under repeated attacks
Three Baker rooms use existing authored loops; other stages retain the old generic fallback
Enabled versus disabled sound preserves complete CPU states, RNG and replay commands
The real experimental page binds native controls without storage, autoplay, messages or extra loops
All gameplay contracts, rosters, art, existing workbooks and Baker PCM data remain unchanged
